question_text: Construct an ERD for a repair centre, technicians and assistants. Each technician and each assistant works at exactly one centre. A centre has many technicians and assistants. A technician works with many assistants and an assistant works with many technicians. Show cardinalities.
adaptation_rationale: ERD relationship cardinalities remain directly scoped. Scenario and wording rewritten; source reasoning retained only within supported 2027 scope.
solution: Centre 1—many Technician; Centre 1—many Assistant; Technician many—many Assistant. A correctly keyed link entity may replace the many-to-many relationship.

marking_points.criterion: Correct technician-assistant many-to-many relationship, directly or through link entity.
